svg.title: AMIGA — learning which consensus network to choose
svg.desc: Conceptual AMIGA core workflow, based on repository commit 1eaef45bee2d58807e8563b01eefee4724fe4b2f. All matrices, fronts, network diagrams and score bars are schematic, not empirical results. No reference image or generative image model is used by the builder.
svg.text: From alternative consensus networks to a ranked recommendation — without reference labels at prediction time.
Known reference links reveal which candidates deserve higher priority.
Recommend a network for new data
The learned decision rule scores new candidates without a reference network.

g.text: One table row per candidate network
expression context is shared by a front.
Learn to rank within each front
Features predict an ordering, not a cutoff
Prefer candidates with higher quality labels
Refit on all labelled fronts after CV
One table row per candidate network
Choose one network or a short list
Output: score + rank within each front

svg.text: Quality labels supervise learning; they are not prediction inputs.
AMIGA prioritizes existing candidates; it does not generate a new network.
Schematics, not experimental results. Ranking scores are not measured network accuracy.
